name: 1013-longprompt-llama3-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct -- an ungated re-upload of the gated meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct weights.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, 8192 trained positions, bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 800 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompts 5120 +- 768 tokens (clamped 3072-7168), generations 256 +- 64 (clamped 64-512), every request an independent draw, seed 42.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing long reports for 32 concurrent users on a single 80GB GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- the reader takes this file line by line and skips indented
# lines, so a nested value is dropped and the server starts without it at rc=0.

# NousResearch's re-upload rather than `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct`, which is
# gated. The path must still lowercase to something containing "llama-3" and "instruct":
# that is how this engine picks a chat template.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
context-length: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
chunked-prefill-size: 2048
max-running-requests: 64
random-seed: 42
